title: Run and publish the first on-silicon FI campaign on the U585: RDP-2 fetch, FSBL verify chain, gated_unlock, c10 ct_eq gate
threat: Every FI gate in the tree is evidenced only by source shape, host tests and Unicorn emulation; HW-ASSUME-RDP2 (RDP-2 resists glitching) is the single highest-leverage unverified premise. Bozzato/Focardi 2019 downgraded RDP-2→RDP-1 on STM32F373 with one 11 µs glitch; Kraken/Unciphered did the same class on F2/F4; Donjon glitched Safe 3's MCU integrity check; μ-Glitch defeated TZ-M on the L5 sibling; Šimoník reports ~76% PIN-check bypass on a U5 sibling. Neither Trezor nor Ledger has published a U5 data point.
proposal: Treat it as a release gate with receipts: (1) Scaffold/ChipWhisperer-Husky crowbar + PicoEMP campaign on a sacrificial RDP-2 pq1 board, sweeping the boot-time option-byte fetch (RDP/TZEN latch) for RDP-1 behaviour; (2) glitch sweep of fsbl::filter_valid + verify_images with a deliberately corrupted slot (goal: branch into unsigned slot); (3) gated_unlock pre-commit bump and the SE verdict sentinel with a wrong PIN (goal: unlock or no page-124 charge); (4) c10_sign_verified ct_eq/verify gate with a grafting oracle (Genêt's SPHINCSplus-FA tooling) to measure exploitable-fault rate with the double-compute ON vs OFF; (5) fixed-vs-random TVLA (1k traces) on the secret-seed PRF to put a number on F-16. Publish scripts + traces under tools/bench as reproducible evidence (Ledger does not publish its own).
rationale: Converts 'countermeasures present' into 'countermeasures measured' and either closes HW-ASSUME-RDP2 or forces the design to stop leaning on it. Both the FSBL (frozen forever after RDP-2 per invariant #10) and the first-boot ceremony depend on this answer, so it must precede the shipping ceremony, not follow it.

vendor_precedent: Ledger Donjon runs Scaffold/laser/EMFI campaigns on its own and competitors' parts and publishes write-ups (Safe 3, TROPIC01, Tangem, RP2350); Trezor's U5 resistance claim rests on 'no public attack yet' — same unevidenced assumption pq1 currently shares.
risks: Burns sacrificial boards; a positive RDP-downgrade result would force a redesign of the verify-once-physically story (but that is exactly why it must run first). Campaign must be fault-model-complete (voltage, clock, EM; laser out of budget) and must not be read as proof of absence beyond the swept windows.
